note: MPW grouped EXPORT/IMPORT syntax: a parenthesized group `(a,b,c):type` expands to the individual symbols a, b, c, each carrying the shared :type suffix (Start/StartLog `export (InitParm,FrameParms1,MainWindow):code`, `import (InitParm,TitLine):code`). asm.py _dir_export kept the whole `(...)` group as one bogus symbol; _dir_import shredded it with a plain comma split. A shared _iter_sym_decls helper now expands both. Here A and B each become real EXPORTed labels (GLOBAL records in the OMF).
